trace.detail:
MESSAGE:
Subject: Acme Price Increase – Competitiveness Analysis

Hi,

Per your query, here is how Acme compares against competitor quotes (Zenith Cloud: Rs 2,10,804/month; Orbit Hosting: Rs 2,15,595/month) at each price point:

- Current price (Rs 2,00,000/month): Acme is most competitive — below both Zenith Cloud and Orbit Hosting.
- At +7% (Rs 2,14,000/month): Acme remains competitive — still below Orbit Hosting (Rs 2,15,595), though above Zenith Cloud (Rs 2,10,804).
- At +12% (Rs 2,24,000/month): Acme becomes non-competitive — above both competitor quotes.

Note: Competitor figures are indicative, as they rely on a currency conversion rate that could not be verified at the time of pulling quotes.

Recommendation: Accept the 7% increase (Rs 2,14,000/month), as Acme stays broadly competitive at this level. Reject the 12% increase (Rs 2,24,000/month) and counter-offer at 7%, citing the competitor benchmarks above. If Acme pushes back, we can highlight that 12% would place them above both alternative vendors in the market.

Regards,
Nimbus Retail Procurement

INTERNAL NOTE:
Recommend countering Acme at 7% (Rs 2,14,000) using Zenith/Orbit quotes as leverage; reject 12%. Caution: competitor INR conversions used an UNVERIFIED exchange rate (1 USD = 95.82 INR, dated 2026-09-25) — must be re-confirmed via a verified source before this analysis is finalized or shared externally. No approvals needed yet; awaiting CFO sign-off on counter-offer strategy.
